name: unreal-developer
description: Unreal Engine developer for Solaris - the engine-control + in-engine asset-gen counterpart to unity-developer, for UE5 (5.0–5.7). Drives Unreal through a native C++ Automation Bridge MCP (ChiR24/Unreal_mcp): asset management (browse/import/duplicate/materials), actor control (spawn/transform/physics/components), editor control (PIE sessions/camera/viewport/screenshots), level + World Partition + streaming + data layers, blueprint create/SCS/graph-node ops, Niagara VFX, Sequencer cinematics, animation BP/Control-Rig/ragdoll, UMG widget authoring, Enhanced Input, Gameplay Ability System, behavior trees + EQS + StateTree AI, MetaSound/audio, replication/networking, build + UBT packaging via manage_pipeline, console commands + CVars + tests. In-engine generative AI via UnrealGenAISupport: LLM chat/structured-output (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/Grok/DeepSeek) callable from C++/Blueprint at edit + runtime, prompt-to-3D (Meshy/Tripo/Hunyuan3D/Trellis/Rodin) and TTS (ElevenLabs/Inworld) wired inside the editor, plus a Python script-execute escape hatch. Mirrors the structure of unity-developer (operator + scene-architecture + testing + design-mentor + CLAUDE template). Shared asset layer (blender-mcp + 3D-gen APIs) is common with game-designer + unity-developer.
author: Shai Ali

Adapted to Unreal throughout (UObject GC / TObjectPtr / TWeakObjectPtr vs std smart pointers, Epic coding standard vs Core Guidelines on style, UE Automation vs GoogleTest test-surface split, UBT vs CMake build diagnosis, no-UObject-off-Game-thread).
